descriptionHtml:
This interactive technical talk is proudly organized as part of the IEEE Day 2026 celebrations at the University of Peradeniya.
Featuring industry case studies on real-world submarine cable networks, the key areas covered include:

  • The world today and the need for submarine cables

  • Different parts and components of a submarine cable system

  • Submarine cable faults, repairs, and security

  • The impact of AI on submarine cable operations
venue: Drawing Office II, Faculty of Engineering
